items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC13 implemented; each has a unit/RTL or Playwright test; AC8 recorded in spec.md, derived-catalogue.json and triage.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown postcode blocked by validation; unknown BFS throws UnknownMunicipalityError with a German toast; select disabled until an address is picked.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Invoice generation no longer contacts any server; generated data written via JSON.stringify; no secrets touched; patient data stays in the browser.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Behaviour-named tests tagged @FR-01.01/@FR-01.03/@FR-01.05; boundaries mocked only at Supabase/fetch; E2E stubs only the address lookup and asserts no off-origin request.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Snapshot is 29 localities (~4 KB); proposal is a linear scan per render; build size unchanged within noise.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files < 100 LOC; data in src/data, logic in src/lib/municipality.ts, state transition in src/features/form/addressChange.ts.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Generator->generated module->proposeMunicipality exercised on the real CSV; Swiss Post town spellings probed live for 6314/6319/6343/8836/6340/6315 and match the official names.
